body.name: finite count-box and endpoint-grid value
body.construction: \(D_{K,h}(\mathcal K)\) is the supremum over \(\kappa\in\mathcal K\) of the deterministic minimax value over policies that report \(\Theta\) outside \(\mathcal B_K\) and use endpoints in \(\mathcal G_h\) inside \(\mathcal B_K\), with honesty required at every observed share and nuisance value.
